name: Wrapping — Stripping Down Softness
summary: Build anticipation by starting with multiple fabric layers (underwear, sheet, blanket) between the toy and skin, then removing them one by one as arousal builds—each layer increasing intensity.
detailed_description: This is a graded-intensity build using wrapping. Start with several layers stacked between vibrator and skin for the softest, most diffuse buzz, then peel away one layer at a time as arousal rises. Each removed layer brings the vibration closer and stronger, creating anticipation toward the most direct contact.
stepwise_structure: 1. Stack multiple layers between toy and skin (e.g. underwear, sheet, blanket).
2. Begin vibrating through all the layers for the softest sensation.
3. As arousal builds, remove one layer to step up intensity.
4. Continue removing layers one at a time toward more direct contact.
5. Stop at the layer/intensity that feels best.
safety_notes: Step intensity up gradually; don't jump to bare contact before ready.
Add a layer back if it becomes too intense.
